ceiling_directive: Complete the recovered-regime portion of the support-wide profile theorem by proving continuum-uniform honesty and the matching expected-length upper bound on \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{cert}}\), including explicit control of every discretization and fallback remainder.
improvement_directive: Prove that the proposed four-cell profile interval is uniformly honest over the continuum and attains \(L_n^\star(\kappa_n)\asymp r_n\) on \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{cert}}\), with the listed calibration, sieve, transfer, false-split, and fallback terms shown negligible at the stated orders.
critique: The note proves two explicit continuum lower envelopes, a coarse all-strength lower rate, and the exact nonshrinking value only on the flat face; it does not prove the advertised all-strength minimax frontier, an attaining interval, or any upper rate outside that flat limit. The four-cell result calibrates only finite-grid nulls when the true label lies on the grid and the outer program already contains the true bin averages, so it does not establish continuum honesty or usable precision for the proposed profile interval. The deterministic false-cutoff separation theorem does not supply the missing stochastic profile comparison or control the numerous fallback probabilities. Calling \(\lambda_n\to\infty\) information-theoretic cutoff recovery is also unsupported: recovery is defined by that condition rather than established by a recovery theorem. These omissions leave a substantial lower-bound and setup contribution, but not the matched or operational frontier required for a field-tier paper. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
